title: Misir Wot
description: Red lentils cooked down with berbere and a large quantity of onion, which is dry-cooked first without any fat at all. Thick enough to eat with bread rather than a spoon.
notes: Berbere varies enormously in heat between brands. Start with half and build.

ingredients.name: niter kibbeh
ingredients.note: spiced clarified butter; or plain ghee

steps.text: Cook the red onions in a dry pan, with no oil, stirring often until they collapse and release their moisture.
steps.tip: This sounds wrong and is the defining step. The onions steam in their own liquid and go sweet without frying.

steps.text: Add the niter kibbeh, garlic, and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the berbere and tomato paste and cook them out so the spice loses its raw edge.
Add the red lentils and the hot water, and simmer, stirring now and then.
Season with the salt and cook until it is thick enough to hold the mark of a spoon.
